title: Cleveland Cavaliers Are Going To The NBA Finals, Says WWE Super Star The Miz
htmlContent:
Mike “The Miz” Mizanin was recently interviewed by TMZ Sports and shared that the Cleveland Cavaliers are going to the NBA Finals this season.

“We’re going to the NBA Finals. They got a young squad, and they got some good superstars. They look better than the Lakers.

The Cavs are good Cavs are good they're an up and coming like a team that literally people are like passing on and going they're good, but they're not that good. Nah they're that good, " said Miz.

The would then talk about newly acquired All-Star guard Donovan Mitchell.

 “He is the star. And we welcomed him with open arms, ’cause we didn’t think we could get another star. It’s Cleveland. It’s not like an L.A. or NY, or Miami market.”
